items.title: Micron Lags Despite NVIDIA’s $279B Memory Commitment; Western Digital Drops 4%, SK Hynix Ticks Up
items.summary: NVIDIA just disclosed a memory commitment that nearly tripled in a single quarter, yet the stocks of its named suppliers are falling hard on Thursday. One name in the group is bucking the selloff, and the reason points to a fault line running through the entire memory trade.
